title: US AI export program receives 78 full-stack consortium applications
verifiedFacts: The US Commerce Department reported 78 applications for government-supported full-stack AI export packages spanning hardware, data, models, cybersecurity, and applications.
inference: Competitive AI offerings are increasingly evaluated as coordinated value chains rather than standalone products.
significance: Supports relationship mapping across providers, suppliers, builders, buyers, financing, policy, and application layers.
assumptions: Consortium formation is a durable market structure rather than a one-off policy response.
knownLimitations: Application volume does not reveal award quality, deployment, purchasing, or outcomes.
